title: The universal language uses zero space
statement: The language consisting of every finite binary word belongs to $\mathrm{SPACE}(s)$ for the identically zero bound $s(n)=0$: there are a constant $c\in\mathbb N$ and a finite binary Turing machine that decides this language using at most $c s(n)=0$ work-tape cells on every input of length $n$.
